nodes.description: IERC20 public umbToken: the reward token transferred out by the vesting contract.
uint256 public totalVestingAmount: accounting sum of all rewards currently promised.
uint256 public paidSoFar: cumulative amount of tokens already claimed.
mapping(address => Reward) public rewards: per-participant vesting schedule (total, duration, paid, startTime).
address private _owner inherited from Ownable: privileged account controlling distributions.
constructor(address _owner, address _token) Owned(_owner): initialises owner and the reward token.
balanceOf(address _address) public view: computes the vested-but-unpaid amount using block.timestamp.
claim() external: claims the caller's vested tokens via _claim(msg.sender).
claimFor(address[] _participants) external: loops over participants and claims on their behalf.
_claim(address _participant) internal: computes balance, updates accounting and transfers tokens.
addRewards(...) external onlyOwner: registers/updates vesting schedules and totalVestingAmount.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner: transfers privileged control of distributions.
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0), disabling addRewards forever.
owner() public view: returns _owner, used by the onlyOwner access-control check.
_msgSender() internal view: returns msg.sender (Context indirection).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address, used for claim identity and ownership checks.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time source driving vesting progress in balanceOf.
umbToken.transfer(_participant, balance): external call to an arbitrary token contract inside _claim.
rewards[_participant].paid += balance and paidSoFar += balance: raw uint256 additions relying on prior SafeMath-derived bounds.
_address parameter of balanceOf.
_participant parameter of _claim.
_participants array parameter of claimFor.
_participants array parameter of addRewards.
_rewards array parameter of addRewards.
_durations array parameter of addRewards.
_startTimes array parameter of addRewards.
_owner parameter of the LinearVesting/Owned constructor.
_token parameter of the LinearVesting constructor.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
balance local in _claim: vested amount to transfer.
reward local in balanceOf: memory copy of the Reward struct.
sum local in addRewards: running total of promised rewards.
total local in addRewards: existing reward total for a participant.
loop index i in addRewards.
msgSender local in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender().

edges.reason: claim() forwards msg.sender as the claimant identity into _claim.
_claim receives the caller-supplied address used to index rewards.
balanceOf vesting math depends on block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
_address parameter selects which Reward entry balanceOf reads.
_participant parameter drives balanceOf lookup and token transfer in _claim.
_participants array is iterated and each element passed to _claim.
_participants array keys the rewards mapping written by addRewards.
_rewards array supplies the new reward totals written by addRewards.
_durations array supplies the vesting durations stored by addRewards.
_startTimes array supplies the vesting start times stored by addRewards.
Constructor argument _owner becomes the privileged owner via Owned.
Constructor argument _token is stored into the umbToken state variable.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged _owner.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender used in ownership checks.
Ownable constructor derives the initial _owner from _msgSender().
LinearVesting constructor invokes transferOwnership(_owner) through Owned.
onlyOwner modifier calls owner() to gate addRewards.
onlyOwner modifier calls owner() to gate transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier calls owner() to gate renounceOwnership.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership reads the current _owner before overwriting it.
renounceOwnership reads _owner before zeroing it.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner slot.
renounceOwnership zeroes the privileged _owner slot.
claim() calls the internal _claim routine.
claimFor loops and calls _claim for every participant.
_claim computes the owed amount through balanceOf, which depends on block.timestamp.
addRewards calls balanceOf to ensure new rewards are not below already vested amounts.
_claim performs an external token transfer; a malicious token could reenter claim entry points.
_claim performs raw uint256 additions on rewards[_participant].paid and paidSoFar.
local balance flows into the external transfer value.
balance is added to rewards[_participant].paid before the transfer.
balance is added to paidSoFar using raw unchecked addition.
balanceOf copies the Reward struct into the reward local before computing vesting.
addRewards reads the existing rewards[participant].total into the total local.
Difference between total and _rewards[i] is added/subtracted from the sum using SafeMath.
Accumulated sum is written back to the totalVestingAmount state variable.
addRewards overwrites the Reward struct stored in the rewards mapping.
Constructor stores the validated _token into the umbToken state variable.
A hostile token implementation can reenter claim() during umbToken.transfer before/while accounting settles.

normalization_plan.reason: Input parameter is only meaningful as the lookup key of the balanceOf vesting view.
Parameter is consumed solely by the internal _claim payout routine.
Array parameter is iterated exclusively inside claimFor.
Participant array only drives the rewards mapping writes in addRewards.
Reward totals array is used only for the addRewards schedule update.
Durations array is used only for the addRewards schedule update.
Start-time array is used only for the addRewards schedule update.
Owner argument is consumed by the constructor's Owned inheritance setup.
Token argument is assigned to umbToken inside the constructor.
newOwner parameter is only used to overwrite the _owner access-control slot.
Computed balance is the exact value passed to the external umbToken.transfer call.
Memory Reward copy exists only to compute the balanceOf return value.
Running sum is a temporary accumulator later written to totalVestingAmount by addRewards.
Existing total is a temporary read of rewards[...] used inside addRewards.
Loop counter exists only to iterate the addRewards bootstrap loop.
Cached _msgSender() value is used only to initialise _owner during construction.
